_description: HMATS Live HIGH_RISK default. Preserves Kraken-only execution, BTC/ETH/SOL scope, 4H loop, and short-biased high-risk baseline.
_mode_note: P227: `mode` is documentation only — from_file never reads it and main() overwrites config.mode from the CLI unconditionally. The real mode switch is the --mode flag in docker-compose.hetzner.yml.
_coinbase_note: LIVE (updated 2026-08-07; the previous 'Phase A only: read-only' text went stale on 2026-06-13 and was never corrected). coinbase_routing_enabled=true + data/coinbase_routing_state.json phase=DUAL_VENUE routes ALL 3 assets to the Coinbase perp sleeve, which places REAL orders every 4H tick via manage_to_signal (opens/flips/flattens; P198 flip-persistence; P197/P205 protective stops on ALL assets; P206 gated intent; P209 fuse feed). Kraken entries for routed assets are skipped (P152) — the sleeve is the SOLE directional path. Revert to Kraken-only: scripts/coinbase_set_assets.sh "" (inert routing) — but note Kraken then has no directional driver either; that is a full trading stop, not a venue swap.
_l2_churn_note: L2-CHURN 2026-06-13: flip-persistence whipsaw guard. Require an opposing direction signal to persist N consecutive 4H ticks before committing a flip. Set flip_persistence_enabled=false to disable. AC thresholds (min-hold/global/daily) tightened in main.py:~2105 literals.
_trend_layer_note: TREND-LAYER 2026-06-14 (P146): trend-following IS the live decision layer (enforce). Replaces the quant signal with vol-targeted time-series momentum (backtest 3-asset Sharpe ~0.4, PBO 0.42, +5.4%/yr). Operator-chosen enforce on forward-UNCONFIRMED edge; bounded by net cap 0.5 + 20%/asset size cap + existence fuse -5% halt. Currently SHORT the downtrend (margin shorts via B2). Watch PnL; revert to off if it degrades. HMATS_TREND_MODE env overrides.
_v5_1_note: v5.1 DEMOTED 2026-06-13 (P147): set OFF after shadow-IC validation found the harnesses were DEAD — 6188/6190 shadow records over 41d had direction=0 (P2 key-mismatch: funding strategies read funding_rate_8h but engine wrote funding_rate; kyle read current_price but engine had mark_price; vpin/ml_factor inputs/models absent). Promoting them into live ADVISE was promoting noise. P-SHADOW-WIRE (main.py:~7394) re-keys funding+kyle into a shadow-only copy so REAL signals now accumulate; re-enable only after compute_shadow_ic shows IC>0.05 over 30d. vpin_spike (needs computed VPIN threaded) + ml_factor (needs autoencoders trained) still dead — follow-ups.
_v5_1_reenable_note: RE-ENABLED 2026-08-04 (P165) by explicit operator instruction ('loosen live risk'). This is an OVERRIDE, not a validation pass: the P147 re-enable criterion above (compute_shadow_ic IC>0.05 over 30d) has NOT been met and could not be evaluated from the operator laptop — the shadow ledgers live on the hmats-logs/hmats-data volumes, and data/strategy_shadow/ is empty in a checkout. Note the bar has also MOVED since that note was written: P166 replaced the IC>0.05 gate with a cost-aware one (IC positive at every horizon, |t|>=2, expected edge >= 6bps taker x 2.0 margin), under which IC 0.05 is BELOW break-even. Two of the four families were still dead as of P147-c follow-ups. Bounded by: ADVISE authority only (never DECIDE), net exposure cap 0.50 (P144), 20%/asset size cap, and the existence fuse -5%/28d halt. REVERT: set false and redeploy. VERIFY FIRST on the server: docker exec hmats-engine python -X utf8 -m analytics.shadow_ic.compute_shadow_ic — if it reports HOLD with a shortfall, this flag is trading noise.
_v5_1_gate_result_note: DEMOTED AGAIN 2026-08-07 (P204). The verification the P165 note demanded has now actually been RUN — it could not be before, because compute_shadow_ic had never produced a verdict in its life (P199: its price series was the frozen DRL training parquet, ending 2026-03-31, with ZERO overlap with shadow ledgers starting 2026-04-30; and its default prefixes read only the two families that emit nothing). With fresh OHLCV and all four families, the 30d cost-aware P166 gate says: 6 of 9 strategies KILL with n_directional=0 — cascade_anticipation, funding_extreme, kyle_lambda, ofi, stop_hunt_defense, vpin_spike emit literally NOTHING. funding_mean_reversion and funding_post_etf_regime HOLD on n=4-14, statistically meaningless, several with negative IC. The ONLY real result is ml_factor BTC: PROMOTE, n=107, IC +0.181/+0.312/+0.201 at 4/12/24 bars, Sharpe +2.49 — and its autoencoder was trained ~2026-06-13, INSIDE this window, so treat it as a forward-test candidate, not a validated edge (ml_factor ETH HOLD at Sharpe -4.04, SOL KILL). The P165 note said: 'if it reports HOLD with a shortfall, this flag is trading noise.' It does. RE-ENABLE only per-strategy on out-of-sample evidence — note there is currently NO per-strategy gating (main.py:7611 gates one blended ADVISE signal), so that is new work. Re-run: python -X utf8 -m analytics.shadow_ic.compute_shadow_ic --window-days 30
_coinbase_venue_aware_fees_note: ENABLED 2026-08-04 (P165) by explicit operator instruction. Implemented default-OFF by P155e because it LOOSENS the alpha gate: post-Phase-B every routed asset executes on Coinbase (~3/0bps) but alpha-gate friction was priced off Kraken's fee-tier API (~26/16bps), systematically shrinking target_exposure and a leading candidate for the ZERO_EXPOSURE blocker behind the ~7.5 weeks of no trades (P155/P162). Enabling it makes the gate price the venue the asset actually trades on, which is the CORRECT number — but it is still a real loosening, and it was not confirmed as the blocker first (scripts/why_no_trade.py needs the server; ssh hmats does not resolve from this machine). Wrong-way failures fall back to the Kraken tier (conservative) and log [VENUE-FEE]. REVERT: set false and redeploy.
_coinbase_protective_stop_note: ENABLED 2026-08-07 (P197) for SOL ONLY, by explicit operator instruction. Places a REAL resting stop-limit at Coinbase so the perp position is protected if the engine process dies — until now the sleeve had zero venue-resting protection and every exit was a client-side call on the 4H tick. Distance is measured from the position's avg entry price (a fixed-risk stop, not trailing). SOL-first is the P141 rollout: watch a full [COINBASE-STOP] PLACED -> OK_EXISTS -> FLAT_CANCELLED cycle before widening. WIDEN: empty the assets list to cover BTC/ETH. REVERT: set pct to 0 and redeploy (pct<=0 disables the feature entirely). PRE-FLIGHT (read-only, places nothing): python -X utf8 scripts/coinbase_stop_validate.py --pct 0.10 — verified 2026-08-07, all three contracts preview ACCEPTED. CAVEAT: CDE rejects reduce_only, so the stop is a plain order; it is reconciled every tick and cancelled the moment the asset is flat, because an orphan stop would OPEN an opposite position.
_coinbase_stop_widen_note: WIDENED to all routed assets 2026-08-07 (P205). SOL-only was the deliberate P141 one-asset-first rollout (P197); SOL has since run PLACED -> OK_EXISTS cleanly with no churn and no duplicate orders. BTC and ETH were left routed and trading with NO venue-resting protection, which the P202 [CUTOVER-GUARDS] CRITICAL correctly reported once per process for each. An empty list means EVERY routed asset is covered, so this both closes the gap and self-extinguishes that alert. Pre-flight re-run immediately before widening: all three preview ACCEPTED (BTC SELL @57955, ETH SELL @1725.5, SOL BUY @80.82). REVERT: set coinbase_protective_stop_pct to 0 (disables the feature entirely), or list a subset here to narrow it again.
_coinbase_flip_persist_note: ADDED 2026-08-07 (P198). The Coinbase sleeve is driven by _last_quant_directions raw, so it inherited NONE of the P142 Layer-2 churn controls: BTC flipped direction 29 times in 54 days while the sleeve lost 5.64% (Sharpe -4.5, coinbase_sleeve_pnl.jsonl 2026-06-14 -> 08-06). A sign-FLIP of a live position must now persist this many CONSECUTIVE 4H ticks before executing; single-tick reversals hold. Entries, adds, reduces and flattens are NEVER deferred (exits stay instant, P195 principle). Tightening-only. REVERT: set 0 and redeploy.
_coinbase_use_gated_intent_note: ENABLED 2026-08-07 (P206) by explicit operator decision. The Coinbase sleeve is the ONLY venue that places orders since Phase B, and it was driven from _last_quant_directions — captured at main.py:6480/:7834, BEFORE engine.decide() at :9737. So the alpha gate (Non-Negotiable Rule #1), veto chain, net cap, existence fuse and anti-churn all ran and bound on NOTHING (P201). This routes the sleeve through the gated intent instead, via sleeve_direction_from_intent(), which translates ORDER semantics into POSITION-TARGET semantics — see P206 for the five ways the naive mapping liquidates the book (notably EXPOSURE_DELTA_BELOW_THRESHOLD means HOLD, not FLAT). EXPECTED ON ACTIVATION: the alpha gate currently refuses ETH (30bps < 47bps threshold) and SOL (10bps < 59bps) and passes BTC (dir=+0.9998) — so ETH and SOL FLATTEN (closing an ETH long and a SOL short) and BTC stays long. That is Rule #1 binding on the venue that trades, for the first time since Phase B. This does NOT connect P144/existence-fuse/sizing: they measure _paper_positions (permanently empty) and speak target_exposure, which the +/-1-contract sleeve discards — signal reconnected, book not. REVERT: set false and redeploy; positions are then managed from the pre-gate signal again.
_fast_risk_sleeve_note: ENABLED 2026-08-08 (P228) by explicit operator decision, same deploy as the P227 sleeve branch. FastRiskTick (30s inter-tick watchdog) may now act on the Coinbase sleeve: EXIT_ONLY flattens via execute_target(0) (works under a halt per P195; the resting protective stop is cancelled first per P197 ordering, no orphan); REDUCE_50 at 1-contract granularity is a logged no-op; a stale venue snapshot refuses to act (P141). Before this the watchdog early-returned on the empty Kraken book every 30s — the sleeve's only inter-tick protection was the venue-resting stop. WORST CASE if wrong: an unwanted flatten on a >=3% inter-tick move against the position — the action FastRiskTick was designed to take. REVERT: set false and redeploy; triggered-but-disabled actions then log one warning per asset.
_p236_decision_note: OPERATOR DECISIONS 2026-08-08 (delegated; P236). (1) alpha_gate_hold_ratio=0.65: a held sleeve position survives an alpha-gate fail iff alpha >= 0.65 x threshold AND the signal still agrees with the held direction — flips and real decay still exit; enabled on the P231 research (Constantinides band) + P234's behavioral tests, with BTC sitting ~1bp above its threshold (the exact 16bps-per-flap case the band exists for). REVERT: remove the key. (2) coinbase_reentry_cooldown_ticks=2: 8h entry-from-flat cooldown after a sleeve flatten (P168 semantics; exits never deferred). REVERT: remove. (3) CALIBRATION TRIPWIRE: trading continues on the asserted alpha constants (trend 40 x 0.75) ONLY through the 4-report dual-log window — weekly Monday slope_calibrator reports, first 2026-08-11, fourth 2026-09-01. If report #4 still shows GATE-CLOSED for an asset and the p221b retrain has not produced a promotable basis, that asset's trend injection comes OFF. This note is the record; the P236 CLAUDE.md entry is the reasoning.
_trend_regime_gate_note: ADDED 2026-08-07 (P198), SHADOW = measurement only, no live change. Trend-following's live loss concentrates in WEAK_CONSOLIDATION (n=364, hit 45.3%, -9.1bps/4H-tick, negative on all 3 assets) and NEUTRAL_DRIFT (n=11, -68.9bps), while QUIET_ACCUMULATION is mildly positive (+2.6bps) — measured 2026-06-14 -> 08-06, which is IN-SAMPLE, hence shadow-first. Logs would-gate verdicts to data/trend_regime_shadow.jsonl every tick. PROMOTE to "enforce" (zeroes trend in gated regimes -> sleeve flattens there) only on forward evidence: python scripts/trend_regime_review.py after >=3-4 weeks of accumulation.
_drl_note: P198 2026-08-07: drl.force_active=false makes the promotion gate's persisted level authoritative. Since 2026-04-11 a [DRL_FORCE_ACTIVE] block in main.py re-promoted ANY persisted level to ACTIVE on every boot whenever models loaded, so demotion (auto or manual) was cosmetic across restarts. DRL demoted ACTIVE -> SHADOW 2026-08-07 (state file on hmats-data volume): live IC +0.019 (4h, ns) / -0.081 (16h, t=-2.78 NEGATIVE) over 2026-06->08, +0.052 in Apr-Jun — no stable edge in two independent live windows, and the backtest Sharpes were P164-leak artifacts. In SHADOW the DRL still runs inference and logs signals every tick (IC monitoring continues) but is excluded from fusion (integration_v36 admits DRL only at EXIT_ONLY/ACTIVE). Iron Law 8 logs ONE expected CRITICAL per process start ([CUTOVER-IRON-LAW-8], observe-only) — that alert is the demotion being SEEN, not a fault. RE-PROMOTE only via a clean retrain (causal pipeline, P164/P179-P184 fixes) that passes the P182 baselines + P166 cost-aware gate on FORWARD data.

exchange._p230_note: from_file reads ONLY exchange.primary (absent here -> default 'kraken'). The api_*_env names below are never parsed — ProductionConfig's hardcoded defaults happen to match; kept as documentation. rate_limit/ws_enabled/rest_enabled removed 2026-08-08 (P230): zero consumers repo-wide; real rate limiting lives in defense/rate_limit_manager.py + the infra/kraken_client.py token bucket.

risk._caps_authority_note: risk.per_asset_caps is ADVISORY (not consumed by main.py). Live sizing uses exposure_caps (pre-leverage, read at main.py:7565/11259/11327) and post_leverage_caps (after leverage, main.py:12861). Keep values consistent across sections.
risk._net_cap_note: NET-CAP 2026-06-14: caps |net signed exposure| (BTC+ETH+SOL). The book ran +0.54 net-long into a -23% market = ~half the Apr-Jun loss; gross caps don't constrain net direction. 0.50 allows a real directional/trend tilt but blocks all-in net-long. Only reduces requests that increase |net|; de-risking always free. Set null to disable.

alpha_gate._description: Mirror HIGH_RISK paper/live behavior: keep EV gate active but allow medium-strength QUIET_ACCUMULATION entries.
alpha_gate._short_tighten_note: 2026-04-08: Raised SHORT direction floors to match high_risk.json. Only high-conviction shorts pass.

signal_quality._description: Mirror HIGH_RISK paper/live add-on logic: keep the global quality gate, but let BTC long add-ons clear at mid-50s.

structure_gate._description: Mirror paper HIGH_RISK behavior: keep fractal confirmation as the preferred trigger, but allow reduced-size entries when net edge is positive and price is already near the break. Longs stay OPPORTUNITY-only; shorts may also soft-override in NORMAL during quiet/weak regimes, still at reduced size.

trade_gate._description: Mirror paper HIGH_RISK trade-gate behavior: keep the default edge multiplier, but let BTC long setups use a narrower execution-time edge check once alpha gate has already passed.

g6._description: G6 should be a bounded live sizing authority in HIGH_RISK live. Keep clamps bounded, but avoid equal-weight shadowing.

allocation._description: AggressiveAllocator stays bounded, but opens after a smaller sample so HIGH_RISK can concentrate sooner once fills exist.

tranche._description: Mirror HIGH_RISK paper/live behavior: keep the heavier tranche curve, but lower only the new-entry volume-collapse guard so quiet SOL/ETH weekend entries can still seed T1 when edge is present.

_p227_dead_keys_removed: 2026-08-08 audit: removed single_exchange_mode (only reader was the orphan core/cloud_config.py, reading a different key), allowed_venues (zero references repo-wide — and it said kraken while the sole order venue is Coinbase), and the logging block (zero consumers; logging is hardcoded at main.py:81-104 to logs/hmats.log, 10MB x 5 rotation — the daily/90-day values here were fiction). None of these keys ever controlled anything; keeping them made the config overstate what it enforces.
